material_findings.finding: Generation behavior was materially shaped by hidden runtime adapter constants and token allocation. A dynamic allocator overrode task policy; temperature was hardcoded until promoted to an explicit route parameter; prompt examples themselves triggered language drift.
material_findings.current_transfer: ClayCode/H1/H2 must version and replay inference policy inputs separately from model weights/prompt text, including token caps, sampling parameters, fallback policy and context truncation. Behavioral equivalence must include adapter state.

material_findings.finding: Email evolved from a narrower Thunderbird/Gmail-shaped surface to provider-agnostic IMAP-first execution with persistent config/outbox, retry/backoff, attachment handling, thread identity, rate limiting, undo boundaries and explicit fallback feedback.
material_findings.current_transfer: Harness effect semantics should model proposal -> queued/pending -> committed/failed/rolled-back states, retry identity, idempotency, user-visible truth and provider portability; tool availability must not be inferred from model narration.

material_findings.finding: Deprecated wallpaper/wake-word and incorrect memory/email descriptions survived in self-knowledge until explicitly removed/corrected.
material_findings.current_transfer: FRANK self-knowledge must be derived from current authoritative topology/capability state or validated projections, not stale copied prose. ClayGraph/UDB should preserve capability/version provenance.

material_findings.finding: Real correctness failures occurred at regex boundaries, cross-thread undo state, delayed layout, focus routing and attachment double-build, despite backend logic existing.
material_findings.current_transfer: Reference Harness must include UI/effect-path races and lifecycle boundaries where they alter whether intended user actions actually occur; surface state is not decorative when it gates effects.

material_findings.finding: A process could remain systemd-active while Tk main loop was frozen; heartbeat staleness plus force-kill/lock cleanup/restart was added.
material_findings.current_transfer: Recovery acceptance must test liveness at the semantic loop/heartbeat level, not only process existence. Crash/freeze recovery should clear stale ownership artifacts and produce receipts.

material_findings.finding: PyInstaller dependency omission and missing native build packages broke clean-machine startup/install; subsequent clean-VM tests were source-reported.
material_findings.current_transfer: H3/project-hardware acceptance needs reproducible clean-environment package/dependency closure and should treat source-reported historical test counts as secondary until rerun.

negative_results: Task-specific response policy can be silently defeated by a lower-level token allocator.
Natural-language prompt examples can act as unintended behavior triggers.
Hard-coded self-knowledge becomes false as topology changes.
Process active does not imply UI/event-loop live.
Blocking sleeps and cross-thread mutation in undo/effect flows create race/freeze risk.
Regex intent routing without boundary tests creates false-positive tool activation.
Bundled binaries can fail even when source-mode dependencies work.
Provider-specific assumptions leak into folders/auth/SMTP and reduce portability.
Prompt-only output-format constraints leak translations/meta-commentary without validation.
